passages.text:
A/AID will likely to meet with YT CEO in Davos.
Key topic will be how to help content creators to monetise their services and perhaps a few key
countries this can be done at, as well as build civic engagement / resilience.
Please enter your input by Friday, January 12th, 1 pm.
Ty!
See (SBU) Davos 2024 Recommendations - Meeting with Alphabet / Google Leadership,
including the ask for YouTube to improve the discovery and monetization of content in
Belarusian language
• Monetization (inside Russia): YouTube has deactivated monetization for anyone
located inside Russia and for any views that occur inside Russia. This has removed a
key revenue source for independent publishers and at the same time made it easier for
the Government of Russia to advance its plans for a sovereign internet. ASK: Is Google
willing to consider allowing content producers registered and based physically outside of
Russia to monetize views from inside of Russia on content that otherwise adheres to the
YouTube terms of service?
• Targeting/advertising (inside Russia): Russian CSOs and independent media based
outside of Russia can't target or advertise content to audiences inside Russia. ASK: Will
Google allow organizations on an inclusion list (created and managed by an
independent and trusted press freedom NGO like Internews) to buy and publish ads
inside Russia and target content to users inside Russia?
Discovery of content (Russia): Websites blocked in Russia, including for independent
media and groups that are trying to stop the war, are being downgraded in search
results. Search algorithms register user behavior such as whether a user who clicked on
a search result returns to the results page (i.e. they didn't find what they were looking
for). If so, the page is considered a low quality result. If a website is blocked, then many
users return to the search results. This sends a false signal to the search engine and
search algorithms become amplifiers of censorship. ASK: Will Google consider allowing
pages belonging to entities on the inclusion list to not be downgraded in results?
• YouTube monetization (Moldova). We have heard consistently that YouTube
monetization is critical to the development of the digital ecosystem in emerging
democracies. In Moldova for example YouTube monetization could provide financial
sustainability to content creators providing alternatives to Russian propaganda, which
undermines Moldovan democracy. ASK: Does YouTube have a timeline for rolling out
monetization in Moldova?
